skill.name: technical-seo-checker
skill.description: Audits crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, migrations, structured data, and international SEO.
skill.summary: Find technical SEO blockers and produce an evidence-based repair plan.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown fences, relative documentation links, placeholders, or SEO checklist text. Five findings are confirmed: four executable command recipes and one outbound-network use at SKILL.md lines 98-104; no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Helper commands accept user-supplied URLs and domains.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URL schemes and hostnames, pass arguments without shell interpolation, and request consent before running local helpers.

remediation.issue: Audit recipes send domain and URL data to external services.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose crt.sh, Firecrawl, and W3C requests before use, and avoid sending private or staging URLs without approval.

remediation.issue: Index-push commands can notify external search services.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default, require explicit confirmation for --live, and verify site ownership before submission.

content.user_title: Audit Technical SEO and Prioritize Fixes
content.value_statement: Technical defects can block crawling, indexing, and page performance. This skill checks key signals and produces an evidence-based repair plan.
actual_capabilities: Audits crawlability, robots.txt, sitemaps, redirects, and orphan-page patterns.
Reviews indexability signals, including noindex directives, canonicals, duplicates, and HTTP failures.
Evaluates LCP, INP, CLS, mobile usability, HTTPS, and security headers.
Checks URL structure, structured data, hreflang, and AI crawler policies.
Supports bulk URL audits and pre-migration workflows with prioritized findings.
Labels evidence as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
limitations: Live measurements require connected tools, supplied reports, or permission to fetch target URLs.
JavaScript-rendered content may require the documented rendering helper or another browser-based tool.
The skill does not replace Search Console access, server logs, or professional security testing.
Recommendations require human review before production configuration or index submissions.

use_cases.title: Diagnose an indexing decline
use_cases.description: Review crawl barriers, canonical conflicts, status codes, and sitemap coverage after organic traffic drops.

use_cases.title: Prepare a site migration
use_cases.description: Build a baseline, redirect map, staging checklist, cutover plan, and post-launch comparison.

use_cases.title: Audit an ecommerce catalog
use_cases.description: Sample URL patterns, identify template-level defects, and prioritize fixes by affected page count.

prompt_templates.title: Check one page
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Core Web Vitals and indexability for [URL]. Label each metric source and list the three highest-priority fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused review of one important page.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a domain
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a technical SEO audit for [domain]. Score each area, cite evidence, and separate measured results from estimates.
prompt_templates.scenario: A site owner needs a broad technical health assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Review a large catalog
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk audit URLs from [sitemap]. Group patterns, sample representative pages, estimate affected counts, and produce a portfolio priority queue.
prompt_templates.scenario: An SEO team needs pattern-level findings across many pages.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-migration audit from [old domain and stack] to [new domain and stack], including redirects, staging checks, launch gates, and monitoring.
prompt_templates.scenario: An engineering team needs an advanced migration control plan.

output_examples.input: Audit crawlability and indexability for an ecommerce domain.
output: Crawlability: 6/10. Faceted paths consume crawl capacity, and several product URLs are absent from the sitemap.
Indexability: 5/10. Sampled products show conflicting canonical and noindex signals.
Priority: verify affected templates, remove conflicting directives, update the sitemap, and retest representative URLs.

output_examples.input: Prepare a technical SEO migration checklist.
output: Before launch: capture URL, status, canonical, metadata, sitemap, and performance baselines.
At launch: validate one-hop redirects, robots rules, canonicals, analytics, and critical templates.
After launch: compare results after one, seven, and thirty days, then escalate regressions.

output_examples.input: Review AI crawler handling for a public documentation site.
output_examples.output: Policy decision required: choose open, closed, or split access. Preserve search crawlers, document training restrictions, and verify edge rules after publishing.

best_practices: Provide target URLs, business-critical templates, and recent tool exports when available.
Confirm whether results may be fetched, rendered, stored, or submitted to external services.
Retest representative URLs after fixes and compare against the original evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not present estimated metrics as measured results.
Do not apply broad robots.txt or canonical changes without testing affected patterns.
Do not submit URLs or contact external services without explicit approval.

faq.question: Can this skill crawl an entire website?
faq.answer: It supports bulk audits through sampling and pattern grouping. Complete crawling depends on connected tools and site access.

faq.question: Does it measure Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: It can interpret PageSpeed or CrUX data and documented helper results. Without data access, it marks metrics unavailable or estimated.

faq.question: Can it audit JavaScript-rendered pages?
faq.answer: Yes, when a rendering tool is available. It can compare raw HTML with rendered content to identify hydration gaps.

faq.question: Does it change robots.txt or site settings?
faq.answer: No automatic change is required. It recommends fixes, and production changes need user review and approval.

faq.question: Can it support a domain migration?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers baselines, redirect mapping, staging checks, launch gates, and post-launch comparisons.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for Search Console?
faq.answer: No. Search Console, server logs, and analytics provide authoritative data that improves the audit.
